verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमस्त्विति संहृष्टः शक्रस्त्रिदशवद्धनः। संदिदेशाग्रतः सोमं युद्धाय शिशिरायुधम्॥१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: सह सङ्गम्येति। अल्पतोयत्वान्मया एकाकिना हन्तुमशक्योऽपि चन्द्रसंयोगात् बहुलीभावं प्राप्य और्वाग्निर्वारयितुं शक्यते इत्यर्थः॥७७॥

verses.sanskrit:
शक्र उवाच।
              गच्छ सोम सहायत्वं कुरु पाशधरस्य वै। असुराणां विनाशाय जयाय च दिवौकसाम्॥२॥
verses.english: “सोम,” इन्द्र said to moon in a war-warm-up mood, “join hands with the wielder of noose, raingod वरुण, in destroying demons and for the victory to the inhabitants of the sky…
verses.bhavadeepa: षट्चत्वारिंशकेऽध्याये दैत्यमायानिबर्हणम्। कालनेमिसमुद्योगः सुरत्रासोऽनुवर्ण्यते॥१॥ एवमिति। अत्र सामेः शक्रेण प्रार्थितः स्वपक्षानप्यसुरानक्षिणोदित्युच्यते। यद्वा "बृहस्पतिर्हि शुक्रो भूत्वेन्द्रस्याभयायासुरेभ्यः क्षयाय" इति मैत्रायणिश्रुतेर्बृहस्पतिवच्चन्द्रोऽपि रूपभेदं कृत्वा असुरनाशायैवासुरं कर्म कृत्वा तत्साहाय्येन महान्तं तारकामयं सङ्ग्राममुपक्रान्तवानिति समाधेयम्। शिशिरायुधं हिमप्रहरणम्॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: त्वमप्रतिमवीर्यश्च ज्योतिषां चेश्वरेश्वरः। त्वन्मयं सर्वलोकानां रसं रसविदो विदुः॥३॥
verses.english: With sprawling lions, tigers and elephants, and uproarious with roaring soldiery - यूथपा-s = माया-योद्धा-s; further, those mountains are infested with hosts of - ईहा-मृग गणा-s – AI creatures, automated monsters, robots, and cybots etc. while the wind-hit trees are swaying, uprooting and falling distantly on targets…

verses.sanskrit: क्षयवृद्धी तवाव्यक्ते सागरस्येव मण्डले। परिवर्तस्यहोरात्रं कालं जगति योजयन्॥४॥
verses.english: When इन्द्र achieved victory and demon मय met with discomfiture, all the quarters became clear and Vedic rituals recommenced…
verses.bhavadeepa: ज्योतिषामीश्वरः सूर्यः तस्यापीश्वरः। “चन्द्रमसा वाव सर्वाणि ज्योतींषि महीयन्त" इति श्रुतेः। अयमर्थः- यथा पार्थिवं दारु अग्नेर्वर्धकम् एवं चान्द्रमम्भः सर्वेषां दिव्यानामबिन्धनानां तेजसां वर्धकम् अतश्चन्द्रोऽपि सूर्यस्येश्वर इति॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: लोकच्छायामयं लक्ष्म तवाङ्के शशसंज्ञितम्। न विदुः सोमदेवापि ये च नक्षत्रयोगिनः॥५॥
verses.english: A regularly correlative waxing and waning, or ebbing and tiding are manifest in you and in ocean, while you two are capable of recouping the waned and ebbed portion of yours… as such, you joins hands with ocean god varuNa to combat demons… because you spin day and night you are a calibrator for time measurement…
verses.bhavadeepa: परिवर्तसि परिवर्तयसि॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: त्वमादित्यपथादूर्ध्वं ज्योतिषां चोपरि स्थितः। तमश्चोत्सार्य वपुषा भासयस्यखिलं जगत्॥६॥
verses.english: Air infused with fire and fire suffused with air, and undergoing an ictus of era-ending anger, as it were, that twosome airfire has incinerated the demonic army …
verses.bhavadeepa: लोकच्छायामयां भूमिप्रतिबिम्बरूपम् अङ्के उत्सङ्गे। अयं भावः- यथा दर्पणं प्राप्य परावृत्ता नयनरश्मयः ग्रीवास्थमेव मुखं दर्पणगतमिव पश्यन्ति एवं चन्द्रमण्डलं प्राप्य परावृत्तास्ते दूरत्वदोषात् पृथिवीम् अव्यक्तरूपामिव चन्द्रमण्डलगतां पश्यन्ति स एव चन्द्रे कलङ्क इत्युपचर्यते। देवापि देवा अपि॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतभानुर्हिमतनुर्ज्योतिषामधिपः शशी। अब्दकृत्कालयोगात्मा ईज्यो यज्ञरसोऽव्ययः॥७॥
verses.english: Abiding above the solar path and other luminous bodies you dispel gloom and brighten the entire world with your body and beams…

verses.sanskrit: ओषधीशः क्रियायोनिरम्भोयोनिरनुष्णभाक्। शीतांशुरमृताधारश्चपलः श्वेतवाहनः॥८॥
verses.english: Medicne-lord, measure-for-ritual-events, fount-for-ritual-water, heatless-candent, cold-rayed, cornerstone-of-अम्ब्रोसिa, mercurial-natured, vehicle-silvery…
verses.bhavadeepa: यज्ञरसः सोमरसाहुतिपूर्वकेण वर्षादिरूपेण। “अग्नौ प्रास्ताहुतिः सम्यगादित्यमुपतिष्ठते आदित्याज्जायते वृष्टिर्वृष्टेरन्नं ततः प्रजाः" इति स्मृतेः। अव्ययः प्रवाहनित्यः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: त्वं कान्तिः कान्तवपुषां त्वं सोमः सोमवृत्तिनाम्। सौम्यस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां तिमिरघ्नस्त्वमृक्षराट्॥९॥
verses.english: You are lambency, enviable by you conformation, elixir of life, and the life of those who depend on your elixir, सोम-रस, namely सोम-जीविका-स्, i.e., gods who are the sippers of सोम… your charm charms in every charming object, dispeller of darkness for every being, and you are the star-lord…
verses.bhavadeepa: अम्भोयोनिरिति यज्ञरसत्वोपादानम्॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: तद्गच्छ त्वं सहानेन वरुणेन वरूथिना। शमयस्वासुरीं मायां यया दह्याम सङ्गरे॥१०॥
verses.english: Such as you are you charge with your array accompanying raingod वरुण, and quench this factitious fire with which we are being burnt…” so said indra to soma…
verses.bhavadeepa: सोमवृत्तीनां सोमजीविकानां देवानाम्॥९॥

verses.sanskrit:
सोम उवाच।
              यन्मां वदसि युद्धार्थे देवराज जगत्पते। एष वर्षामि शिशिरं दैत्यमायापकर्षणम्॥११॥
verses.english: Such as you are you charge with your array accompanying raingod वरुण, and quench this factitious fire with which we are being burnt…” so said indra to soma…
verses.bhavadeepa: वरूथिना सेनावता॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: एतान्मच्छीतनिर्दग्धान्पश्य त्वं हिमवेष्टितान्। विमायान्विमदांश्चैव दानवांस्त्वं महामृधे॥१२॥
verses.english: “With which confidence you are asking me to combat the whirlfire that I will keep up by just storming icestorms on demons that repulses this fictional whirlfire… you may behold how demons will be divested of their wizardry and haughtiness when burnt with my chill and covered with sleet…” so said moon to indra…

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततो हिमकरोत्सृष्टाः सुबाष्पा हिमवृष्टयः। वेष्टयन्ति स्म तान्घोरान्दैत्यान्मेघगणा इव॥१३॥
verses.english: Then dew-maker moon hurled sleetstorms mixed with raindrops and snow that spiralled round the deadly demons like cloudcovers…

verses.sanskrit: तौ पाशशुक्लांशुधरौ वरुणेन्दू महारणे। जघ्नतुर्हिमपातैश्च पातघातैश्च दानवान्॥१४॥
verses.english: Those two, the raingod - the wilder of noose; and the moongod - the wielder of moonbeams; started striking the demons with snowfalls and rainfalls…

verses.sanskrit: द्वावम्बुनाथौ समरे तौ पाशहिमयोधिनौ। मृधे चेरतुरम्भोभिः क्षुब्धाविव महार्णवौ॥१५॥
verses.english: Those two, the raingod - the wilder of noose; and the moongod - the wielder of moonbeams; started striking the demons with snowfalls and rainfalls…

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यामाप्लावितं सैन्यं तद्दानवमदृश्यत। जगत्संवर्तकाम्बोधैः प्रवृष्टैरिव संवृतम्॥१६॥
verses.english: Terrorising hosts of gods, pervading all ten directions, he looked to have risen as an overbearing and overwrought Death appearing at era-endings…

verses.sanskrit: तावुद्यतांशुपाशौ द्वौ शशाङ्कवरुणौ रणे। शमयामासतुर्मायां देवौ दैतेयनिर्मिताम्॥१७॥
verses.english: Seeing such a demon काल-नेमि on the battlefield, one who is like Death himself unto his enemies, the hearts of celestials wobbled with fear…
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रवृष्टैः प्रकृष्टवर्षेः संवृतं व्याप्तम्॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: शीतांशुजलनिर्दग्धाः पाशैश्च प्रसिता रणे। न शेकुश्चलितुं दैत्या विशिरस्का इवाद्रयः॥१८॥
verses.english: Set afire with cool-beams and water, and noose making them immobile, the daityA-s are anchored like foundered headless-mountains…

verses.sanskrit: शीतांशुनिहतास्ते तु पेतुर्दैत्या हिमार्दिताः। हिमप्रावृतसर्वाङ्गा निरूष्माण इवाग्नयः॥१९॥
verses.english: His arms appeared to be maintaining equiponderance of skies, his feet footballing mountains, and suspires shoving black-clouds to smithereens…

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु दिवि दैत्यानां विपरीतप्रभाणि च। विमानानि विचित्राणि निपतन्त्युत्पतन्ति च॥२०॥
verses.english: On hearing about the terror experienced by the opposers of gods - पूर्व-देवा-s - namely daityA-s, caused to the maximum by firegod and airgod, a demon renowned as काल-नेमि appeared on the battlefield…

verses.sanskrit: तान्पाशहस्तग्रथिताञ्च्छादितान्हिमरश्मिना। मयो ददर्श मायावी दानवान्दिवि दानवः॥२१॥
verses.english: Thereupon beholding the dreadful demon काल-नेमि approach like death himself all the gods headed by इन्द्र have undergone a macabre eeriness…

verses.sanskrit: स शिलाजालविततां गण्डशैलाट्टहासिनीम्। पादपोत्कटकूटाग्रां कन्दराकीर्णकाननाम्॥२२॥
verses.english: On observing the sore straits of his troopers, where some fettered with the noose of raingod and some flaked with snow-flakes, दानव माय could notice the fade of phantastic fire… then he embarked on another phantasm, माया-पर्वत-माय, a trick with tricksy-mountains…
verses.bhavadeepa: पाशहस्तेन वरुणेन ग्रथितान् बद्धान् स्यूतान् मयो ददर्श। मायां च और्वी नष्टां ददर्शेत्यध्याहृत्य योज्यम्॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: सिंहव्याघ्रगजाकीर्णां नदन्तीमिव यूथपैः। ईहामृगगणाकीर्णां पवनाघूर्णितद्रुमाम्॥२३॥
verses.english: In that trick demon माय spun off spanning ranges of mountains with rocky crags and cliffs, peaks thick with thickets of gigantic trees, mountainsides spread with yawning caves and fusty forests…
verses.bhavadeepa: सः मायां ससृजे इति तृतीयेन सम्बन्धः॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: निर्मितां स्वेन पुत्रेण क्रौञ्चेन दिवि कामगाम्। प्रसृतां पार्वतीं मायां ससृजे दानवोत्तमः॥२४॥
verses.english: With sprawling lions, tigers and elephants, and uproarious with roaring soldiery - यूथपा-s = माया-योद्धा-s; further, those mountains are infested with hosts of - ईहा-मृग गणा-s – AI creatures, automated monsters, robots, and cybots etc. while the wind-hit trees are swaying, uprooting and falling distantly on targets…

verses.sanskrit: साश्मशब्दैः शिलावर्षैः सम्पतद्भिश्च पादपैः। निजघ्ने देवसङ्घांस्तान्दानवांश्चाप्यजीवयत्॥२५॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the forty-sixth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the defeat of demons and the entrance of demon काल-नेमि into god-demon war.

verses.sanskrit: नैशाकरी वारुणी च मायेन्तर्दधतस्ततः। अश्मभिश्चायसघनैः किरन्देवगणान्रणे॥२६॥
verses.english: While supervising demon क्रौञ्च assaulted gods with sonorous fizzing of rocks, storms of stones, plunging of trees, and by strewing iron clouds and rocks on the hosts of gods on the battle-field… simultaneously he re-animated demons making the illusion spun by raingod futile and dissipated…
verses.bhavadeepa: दानवोत्तमः देवगणान् किरन् दानवानजीवयत् इति सम्बन्धः॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: साश्मसङ्घातविषमा द्रुमपर्वतसङ्कटा। अभवद्घोरसञ्चारा पृथिवी पर्वतैरिव॥२७॥
verses.english: With a hundred arms upraised to strike in hundred ways, that glorious hundred-faced demon stood like a hundred-peaked-mountain spanning his hundred heads…
verses.bhavadeepa: मायेन्तरिति सन्धिरार्षः॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: नानाहतोऽश्मभिः कश्चिच्छिलाभिश्चाथ ताडितः। नानिरुद्धो द्रुमगणैर्देवोऽदृश्यत संयुगे॥२८॥
verses.english: On seeing his long strides other beings mistook demon काल-नेमि for the god नारायण dawned afresh as another त्रिविक्रम…

verses.sanskrit: तदपभ्रष्टधनुषं भग्नप्रहरणाविलम्। निष्प्रयत्नं सुरानीकं वर्जयित्वा गदाधरम्॥२९॥
verses.english: Although the glorious one and the lord of the universe, गदा-धर, aka विष्णु, is available on the battlefield from the start, he is unperturbed and unexcited with anger on account of his compos mentis – सहिष्णुत्वम्…

verses.sanskrit: स हि युद्धगतः श्रीमानीशो न स्म व्यकम्पत। सहिष्णुत्वाज्जगत्स्वामी न चुक्रोध गदाधरः॥३०॥
verses.english: Wishful to see the mutual onslaught of gods and demons, thereby to assess their strengths and weaknesses, he who resembles a black-cloud arriving at the era-end, and who is conversant with timing of events, that god जनार्दन, aka विष्णु, waited for the proper time to enter into the picture of battle…

verses.sanskrit: कालज्ञः कालमेघाभः समैक्षत्कालमाहवे। देवासुरविमर्दं स द्रष्टुकामो जनार्दनः॥३१॥
verses.english: Thereupon entering on proper time विष्णु ordered the firegod and airgod to deal with the phantastic-mountain-combat created by मय-असुर in that war…

verses.sanskrit: ततो भगवताऽऽदिष्टौ रणे पावकमारुतौ। शमनार्थं प्रवृद्धाया मायाया मयसृष्टया॥३२॥
verses.english: Then firegod and airgod who for themselves are the illimitable entities have now joined hands to become a two-in-one preponderance at the behest of विष्णु to drag-anchor the magic-mountain-sortie from field…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवृद्धावन्योन्यं प्रवृद्धौ ज्वालवाहिनौ। चोदितौ विष्णुवाक्येन तां मायां व्यपकर्षताम्॥३३॥
verses.english: When that असुर काल-नेमि put his best foot forward on the battlefield as war-tramping, for which stamping the airgod could shove his loincloth a little aside, which terrorised all the gods since it indicated that he is primed up for a fresh war – युद्धोन्मुखत…
verses.bhavadeepa: मयसृष्टयेति षष्ठ्याः सुपां सुलुगित्ययादेश इति प्राञ्चः। गौडास्तु- मायाया मयसृष्टायाः प्रवृद्धायाः शमाय वा इत्येव पदं व्युत्क्रमेण पठन्ति॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यामुद्भ्रान्तवेगाभ्यां प्रवृद्धाभ्यां महाहवे। दग्धा सा पार्वती माया भस्मीभूता ननाश ह॥३४॥
verses.english: Air infused with fire and fire suffused with air, and undergoing an ictus of era-ending anger, as it were, that twosome airfire has incinerated the demonic army …
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यपकर्षतां दूरीकृतवन्तौ। अडभाव आर्षः॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit: सोऽनिलोऽनलसंयुक्तः सोऽनलश्चानिलाकुलः। दैत्यसेनां ददहतुर्युगान्तेष्विव मूर्च्छितौ॥३५॥
verses.english: Swerving his broad bloodshot eyes all over, standing upright with upsurged fervour like lofty Mt. मन्दर, he readied himself in battlefield to put whichever host of gods that comes first in eyeshot distance to torch…
verses.bhavadeepa: उद्भ्रान्ते पादे घृष्ट्वा रज्जुखण्डवत् शत्रोर्भ्रामणे वेगो ययोस्ताभ्याम् अत एव प्रवृद्धाभ्याम्॥३४॥

verses.sanskrit: वायुः प्रधावितस्तत्र पश्चादग्निश्च मारुतात्। चेरतुर्दानवानीके क्रीडन्तावनलानिलौ॥३६॥
भस्मावयवभूतेषु प्रपतत्सूत्पतत्सु च। दानवेषु विनष्टेषु कृतकर्मणि पावके॥३७॥
verses.english: Firegod felt accomplished in his work when the limbs of some dAnavA-s are charmed, some fell down, some trying to rise but turning head over heels, while some completely ruined… when airgod shouldered every aircraft of demons down everybody felt that they are relived of the magical spell created by demons, and started eulogising shrIhari…

verses.sanskrit: वातस्कन्धापविद्धेषु विमानेषु समन्ततः। मायाबन्धे विनिर्वृत्ते स्तूयमाने गदाधरे॥३८॥
verses.english: When the daityA-s remained unventuresome, hitherto laid harpy-deterrents in three worlds became null, and the gods everywhere delightedly said ‘excellent, superb, splendid…’
verses.bhavadeepa: भस्मावयवभूतेषु भस्मलेशतां प्राप्तेषु॥३७॥

verses.sanskrit: निष्प्रयत्नेषु दैत्येषु त्रैलोक्ये मुक्तबन्धने। सम्प्रहृष्टेषु देवेषु साधु साध्विति सर्वशः॥३९॥
verses.english: When इन्द्र achieved victory and demon मय met with discomfiture, all the quarters became clear and Vedic rituals recommenced…
verses.bhavadeepa: अपविद्धेषु पातितेषु॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: जये दशशताक्षस्य मयस्य च पराजये। दिक्षु सर्वासु शुद्धासु प्रवृत्ते धर्मसंस्तरे॥४०॥
verses.english: The path of the moon cleared up, the sun placed in his path, all the elements restored to their natural order and men, fond of good conduct, functioned at ease…

verses.sanskrit: अपावृत्ते चन्द्रपथे अयनस्थे दिवाकरे। प्रकृतिस्थेषु लोकेषु नृषु चारित्रबन्धुषु॥४१॥
verses.english: Death so far constrained to cause timely deaths is now unconstrained and he is not causing untimely deaths – अ-काल मृत्यु-s, vedic-litany to firegod resumed, and the gods regularly receiving the shares of fire-oblations have reassumed a regular ushership to heaven for the oblators…

verses.sanskrit: अभिन्नबन्धने मृत्यौ हूयमाने हुताशने। यज्ञभागिषु देवेषु स्वर्गार्थं दर्शयत्सु च॥४२॥
verses.english: The presiding deities of tend directions, दिक्-पालका-स्, are guarding them fairly unhindered to wend their way in their jurisdictions; saintly people have revived their ascesis unhampered by the transgressors…
verses.bhavadeepa: चारित्रबन्धुषु सदाचारप्रियेषु॥४१॥

verses.sanskrit: लोकपालेषु सर्वेषु दिक्षु संयानवर्तिषु। भावे तपसि शुद्धानामभावे दुष्टकर्मिणाम्॥४३॥
verses.english: At that time gods bloc is jubilant while demons camp despaired; dharma is tripodal while a-dharma is a monopod…
verses.bhavadeepa: अभिन्नबन्धने नियतमर्यादे॥४२॥

verses.sanskrit: देवपक्षे प्रमुदिते दैत्यपक्षे विषीदति। त्रिपादविग्रहे धर्मे अधर्मे पादविग्रहे॥४४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: संयानं सम्यगभयेन प्रचरणं तेन वर्तिषु वर्तमानेषु। भावे अभ्युदेय॥४३॥

verses.sanskrit: अपावृते महाद्वारे वर्तमाने च सत्पथे। स्वधर्मस्थेषु वर्णेषु लोकेऽस्मिन्नाश्रमेषु च॥४५॥
verses.english: The empyreal gates – मोक्श कवाटा-s, are wide open while people started to trek on the avenue of virtue; people in this world stood firm with their caste-bound duties, or hermitage bound missions… The ongoing trend of kings bracing the protection of people has picked up from where it has been left off… everywhere eulogies and legends in praise of gods became audible again…

verses.sanskrit: प्रजारक्षणयुक्तेषु भ्राजमानेषु राजसु। गीयमानासु गाथासु देवसंस्तवनादिषु॥४६॥
verses.english: The empyreal gates – मोक्श कवाटा-s, are wide open while people started to trek on the avenue of virtue; people in this world stood firm with their caste-bound duties, or hermitage bound missions… The ongoing trend of kings bracing the protection of people has picked up from where it has been left off… everywhere eulogies and legends in praise of gods became audible again…

verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तकलुषे लोके शान्ते तपसि दारुने। अग्निमारुतयोस्तस्मिन्वृत्ते सङ्ग्रामकर्मणि॥४७॥
verses.english: On hearing about the terror experienced by the opposers of gods - पूर्व-देवा-s - namely daityA-s, caused to the maximum by firegod and airgod, a demon renowned as काल-नेमि appeared on the battlefield…

verses.sanskrit: तन्मया विमला लोकास्ताभ्यां जयकृतप्रियाः। पूर्वदेवभयं श्रुत्वा मारुताग्निकृतं महत्। कालनेमिरिति ख्यातो दानवः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥४८॥
verses.english: Seeing the world with silenced vice and nullified ultra-ascesis with parlous outcome, then firegod and airgod have beaten a retreat from further warring, for which the people at large, rather mother earth, smiled her gratitude at fire and air gods since some of her burden is doffed with war, and sung praise-songs for them…
verses.bhavadeepa: तन्मयास्तत्प्रधानाः जयनं कृतं प्रियं येषां ते जयकृतप्रियाः। क्रिया इति पाठे चयकृतपदं कृतजयक्रिया इति व्याख्येयम्॥४७॥

verses.sanskrit: भास्कराकारमुकुटः शिञ्जिताभरणाङ्गदः। मन्दराचलसङ्काशो महारजतसंवृतः॥४९॥
verses.english: Appearing mountainous like Mt. मन्दर, with an equally lofty crown in the shape of solar disc, adorned with jingling ornaments, mighty biceps bedecked with prestigious bicep-lets, whole body enswathed with high silver gear…
verses.bhavadeepa: पूर्वदेवानां दैत्यानाम् आगतं भयं पूर्वदेवभयम्॥४८॥

verses.sanskrit: शतप्रहरणोदग्रः शतबाहुः शताननः। शतशीर्षा स्थितः श्रीमाञ्छतशृङ्ग इवाचलः॥५०॥
verses.english: Sporting a coppery hair akin to fire that burns summertime dry grass, and a greenish beard, faces with teeth jutting out of lips, his body seemed to be jutting into the interstices of all the three worlds… such is his lofty look…
verses.bhavadeepa: शिञ्जितानि शब्दवन्ति आभरणानि नूपुरादीनि तत्सहितानि अङ्गदानि यस्य॥४९॥

verses.sanskrit: कक्षे महति संवृद्धो हिमान्त इव पावकः॥५१॥
verses.english: His arms appeared to be maintaining equiponderance of skies, his feet footballing mountains, and suspires shoving black-clouds to smithereens…

verses.sanskrit: धूम्रकेशो हरिच्छ्मश्रुर्दंष्ट्रालोष्टपुटाननः। त्रैलोक्यान्तरविस्तारो धारयन्विपुलं वपुः॥५२॥
verses.english: Swerving his broad bloodshot eyes all over, standing upright with upsurged fervour like lofty Mt. मन्दर, he readied himself in battlefield to put whichever host of gods that comes first in eyeshot distance to torch…
verses.bhavadeepa: कक्षे वने हिमान्ते ग्रीष्मे निदाघ इवेति पाठः॥५१॥

verses.sanskrit: बाहुभिस्तुलयन्व्योम क्षिपन्पद्भ्यां महीधरान्। ईरयन्मुखनिःश्वासैर्वृष्टिमन्तो बलाहकाः॥५३॥
verses.english: Terrorising hosts of gods, pervading all ten directions, he looked to have risen as an overbearing and overwrought Death appearing at era-endings…
verses.bhavadeepa: दंष्ट्रालं बहिर्निर्गतदंष्ट्रम् ओष्ठपुटं दंष्ट्रालोष्ठपुटमाननं यस्य स दंष्ट्राकोष्ठपुटाननः॥५२॥

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यगायतरक्ताक्षं मन्दरोदग्रवर्चसम्। दिधक्षन्तमिवायान्तं सर्वान्देवगणन्मृधे॥५४॥
verses.english: Raising his right hand showing his palm as a sign of assurance – अभय हस्तम् – stretching long fingers, full with garlands and ornaments on his body, with a little disordered armour, yet a wonder to have a look, addressed the demons routed by gods, “Get up, stand up, never give up the fight…”
verses.bhavadeepa: वृष्टिमन्तः। नुम् छान्दसः। वृष्टियुक्तानित्यर्थः॥५३॥

verses.sanskrit: तर्जयन्तं सुरगणांश्छादयन्तं दिशो दश। संवर्तकाले क्षुधितं दृप्तं मृत्युमिवोत्थितम्॥५५॥
verses.english: Seeing such a demon काल-नेमि on the battlefield, one who is like Death himself unto his enemies, the hearts of celestials wobbled with fear…
verses.bhavadeepa: मन्दरोदग्रवर्चसं स्वर्गश्रेष्ठ इन्द्रः तद्वद्वर्चो दीप्तिर्यस्य इन्द्रतुल्यमित्यर्थः। “मन्दरो मन्थशैले स्यात्स्वर्गमन्दारयोरपि। (रान्तवर्गे १९६)” इति मेदिनी॥५४॥

verses.sanskrit: सुतलेनोच्छ्रितवता विपुलाङ्गुलिपर्वणा। माल्याभरणपूर्णेन किञ्चिच्चलितवर्मणा॥५६॥
verses.english: On seeing his long strides other beings mistook demon काल-नेमि for the god नारायण dawned afresh as another त्रिविक्रम…

verses.sanskrit: उच्छ्रितेनाग्रहस्तेन दक्षिणेन वपुष्मता। दानवान्देवनिहतानुत्तिष्ठध्वमिति ब्रुवन्॥५७॥
verses.english: When that असुर काल-नेमि put his best foot forward on the battlefield as war-tramping, for which stamping the airgod could shove his loincloth a little aside, which terrorised all the gods since it indicated that he is primed up for a fresh war – युद्धोन्मुखत…

verses.sanskrit: तं कालनेमिं समरे द्विषतां कालसन्निभम्। वीक्षन्ति स्म सुराः सर्वे भयविक्लवमानसाः॥५८॥
verses.english: And when demon काल-नेमि strutted on battlefield clipping demon मय he shone forth like विष्णु walking with Mt. मन्दर…

verses.sanskrit: तं स्म वीक्षन्ति भूतानि क्रमन्तं कालनेमिनम्। त्रिविक्रमं विक्रमन्तं नारायणमिवापरम्॥५९॥
verses.english: Thereupon beholding the dreadful demon काल-नेमि approach like death himself all the gods headed by इन्द्र have undergone a macabre eeriness…

verses.sanskrit: सोच्छ्रयन्प्रथमं पादं मारुताघूर्णिताम्बरः। प्राक्रामदसुरो युद्धे त्रासयन्सर्वदेवताः॥६०॥
समयेनासुरेन्द्रेण परिष्वक्तः क्रमन्रणे। कलनेमिर्बभौ दैत्यः सविष्णुरिव मन्दरः॥६१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: सोच्छ्रयन् सः उच्छ्रयन्निति छेदः। पादपूरणार्थः सुलोपः॥६०॥

verses.sanskrit: अथ विव्यथिरे देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः। दृष्ट्वा कालमिवायान्तं कालनेमिं भयावहम्॥६२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: मयेन परिष्वक्तः॥६१॥
